scope: Activities checked against official pages this session. Drive and transit claims come only from the official page that states them. Blank = not verified (flagged).

activities.name: Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area
activities.address: 1000 Scenic Loop Drive, Las Vegas, NV 89161 (visitor center)
activities.distance_from_strip: 17 miles west of the Strip; 'approx. 30 minutes' (BLM, S13)
activities.public_transit: Public transportation does not extend to Red Rock Canyon (S13). Fails the bus-only test (F02).
activities.hours: Scenic drive timed entry required Oct 1 – May 31, 8:00 am – 5:00 pm (S13). Feb 2027 falls inside this window.
activities.days_open: Not stated as 'daily' on the official page. Timed entry required Oct 1 – May 31, 8:00 am – 5:00 pm (S13).
activities.exceptions: Timed entry ticket required on each day you plan to enter (Oct 1–May 31). Fees and reservations: see BLM fees page linked from S13.
activities.fees: Not captured (see BLM fee page). Flagged.

activities.name: Valley of Fire State Park
activities.address: 29450 Valley of Fire Rd, Overton, NV 89040
activities.distance_from_strip: Drive time NOT stated on the official page (F24)
activities.public_transit: Not stated. Official warning: rideshare may leave visitors stranded because return rides are often unavailable (S14).
activities.hours: Park open daily, sunrise to sunset (S14). Visitor center daily 9:00 am – 4:00 pm (S14).
activities.exceptions: Annual maintenance closure Dec 1–14 (outside trip window). Trail closures May 15–Sep 30 (outside trip window). Group sites by reservation. Day use needs no reservation.

activities.name: Las Vegas Monorail (Strip transit)
activities.address: Seven Strip stations (route map on official site)
activities.public_transit: This IS the rail option. Trains every 4–8 minutes (S12). No subway appears in the official transit sources reviewed (S11, S12), so the bus + monorail interpretation is used (F01).
activities.hours: Monday 7:00 am – 12:00 am; Tuesday–Thursday 7:00 am – 2:00 am; Friday–Sunday 7:00 am – 3:00 am (S12)
activities.exceptions: Early-closure notices apply only Nov 29 – Dec 15, 2026 (outside trip window) (S29).
activities.fees: Not captured in readable text (see S12 ticket page)
activities.social_instagram: @lvmonorail (handle named on official page, S12; account URL not separately verified)

activities.name: The Neon Museum (Neon Boneyard)
activities.address: 770 Las Vegas Blvd. N., Las Vegas, NV 89101
activities.distance_from_strip: Not stated on the official page (F20)
activities.hours: Sep–May: 3:00 pm – 11:00 pm daily, last entry 10:00 pm (S15). Official 'open today' block lists 3 pm – 11 pm for each day of the week.
activities.exceptions: From Jan 1, 2027, admission earlier or later than your ticket time may carry a higher ticket price (S15). Tours cancel above 100°F; general admission closes above 105°F; museum closes above 110°F (S15).
